shots.say: Knock, knock! Tula, can you come out of your shell?
Can a turtle ever leave its shell?
I'm Milo the bluebird. Let's find Tula's shell secrets!
The Animated Zoo!
Tula has three shell secrets. Let's find them, one by one!
Shell secret number one! Can Tula take off her shell, like a coat?
Yes, she can? Or no, she can't?
No! A turtle cannot leave its shell.
Not ever! A turtle and its shell always stay together.
A coat comes off. But a shell is part of the turtle's body!
Look inside! A turtle's shell is made of bones.
This is her backbone. It is joined to her shell.
And these are her ribs. They are joined to her shell, too!
Wow! Her shell is joined to her bones.
Backbone, ribs, and shell. All joined together!
You have ribs, too! Put your hands on your sides, and feel your ribs.
Now touch your back. Your backbone is in there!
So, can Tula come out of her shell?
No! Her shell is a part of her. It goes everywhere with her.
So, Milo, there is no door in Tula's shell. Her shell is Tula!
Say it with me. A turtle's shell is part of its body!
shots.tag: say it: part of its body

shots.say: Quick check! Is Tula's shell made of bones? Yes, or no?
Yes, bones! Great job!
Shell secret number two! When a little turtle grows bigger, what happens to its shell?
Does it get a new shell? Or does its shell grow, too?
Its shell grows! As a turtle grows, its shell grows with it.
Just like your bones grow, when you grow!
A baby turtle has a little shell. A big turtle has a big shell!
You are growing, too! Stretch up nice and tall. So tall!
Look at the top of Tula's shell. Can you see the little plates?
Let's count three plates. One, two, three!
These plates are called scutes. Say it: scutes!
The scutes cover her shell, and help to protect her.
Scutes are made of the same stuff as your fingernails!
Look at your fingernails. Can you tap them? Tap, tap!
Your fingernails, and Tula's scutes. The same stuff!
Tula swims, and grows, and grows. And her shell grows with her!
Look how big Tula is now. And her shell is big, too!
Say it with me. A turtle's shell grows with it!
Quick check! When Tula grows, does her shell grow, too? Yes, or no?
Yes! Super!
Shell secret number three! Can a sea turtle hide its head inside its shell?
Yes, it can? Or no, it can't?
No! A sea turtle's head always stays outside its shell.
Hello, Tula! Your head is always out!
Her flippers stay outside, too. Paddle, paddle!
Many turtles that live on land can pull their heads in. Look! In it goes.
And out it comes again! Hello!
But a sea turtle has no room in its shell for its head.
Can you pull your head in, like a land turtle? Now pop it out!
And one more thing. Can Tula feel a gentle tap on her shell?
Yes! Milo gives Tula a gentle tap. She can feel it!
Her shell has little nerves. So she can feel a touch.
You feel a tap on your fingernail. Tula feels a tap on her shell!
Gently tap your fingernail. You can feel it, too!
Say it with me. A sea turtle's head stays out!
Quick check! Can Tula feel a gentle tap on her shell? Yes, or no?
Yes! You remembered!
Three shell secrets! Now it is quiz time!
Can a turtle take off its shell? Yes, or no?
No! It is joined to her bones.
When a turtle grows, does its shell grow, too? Yes, or no?
Yes! It grows with her.
Can a sea turtle pull its head into its shell? Yes, or no?
No! Her head stays out.
Tula's shell is part of her, it grows with her, and her head stays out. You found all three secrets!
Feel your ribs. Tap your fingernails. And pull your head in, then pop it out!
Next time: what do sea turtles eat? Have a happy swim, Tula!
Thank you, friends! If you like The Animated Zoo, don't forget to like and subscribe, to keep supporting our zoo friends. See you next time!
